prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photoreal 4:5 cinematic rooftop fashion portrait of an adult woman at blue hour. She wears a long-sleeve indigo denim shirt buttoned to the collar, matching wide-leg denim trousers, black knee-high boots, a metallic choker, and a minimal ear cuff. Seat her safely on a broad rooftop garden terrace bench, body angled sideways, one arm resting on her knee. Use a defocused city skyline with warm window bokeh, cool blue shadows, soft diffused frontal key light, low city fill, a warm rim light, 50mm f/1.8 depth of field, and no text or branding.
